items.t: Fuel leak at the pressure regulator in extreme cold (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN; Suzuki stopped selling cars in the US, but recall work is still free.

items.t: Accelerator cable can fray and stick (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN; Suzuki stopped selling cars in the US, but recall work is still free.

items.t: Front brake discs can crack on steep descents (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN; Suzuki stopped selling cars in the US, but recall work is still free.

items.t: Rear differential can lock up from a cracked retainer (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN; Suzuki stopped selling cars in the US, but recall work is still free.

items.t: Transmission shifter shaft problem (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN; Suzuki stopped selling cars in the US, but recall work is still free.

items.t: Worn front lower ball joints
items.job: Replace front lower control arms or ball joints, then align
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $725-$816 per control arm job on 2006-2013 models and much more ($2,392-$2,840) for 1999-2005 models. Alignment is extra.

items.t: Timing chain rattle from the front of the engine
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioners and guides
items.note: RepairPal lists about $2,196-$2,881 for a Grand Vitara timing chain tensioner job. Replacing the chains at the same time adds parts cost.

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
items.job: Reseal timing chain cover
items.note: Most of the cost is the labor to remove the cover, about the same as a tensioner job. RepairPal lists an engine leak inspection at about $122-$179.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifting problems
items.job: Repair or replace automatic transmission
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $1,200 on average. Start with a fluid change (RepairPal: about $143-$191) if the fluid is old.

items.t: Warped front rotors, squealing and pulling
items.job: Front brake pads and rotors
items.note: RepairPal puts a pad replacement at about $276-$333 on these years; rotors add to it.

items.t: A/C evaporator freezes up
items.job: A/C diagnosis and repair per Suzuki bulletin
items.note: RepairPal lists A/C diagnosis at about $122-$179. Parts extra if a sensor or expansion valve is needed; a full evaporator replacement runs about $877-$1,652.

items.t: Exhaust noise from under the SUV
items.job: Replace exhaust hangers or secure heat shields
items.note: An owner paid about $100 for three hangers. A rusted muffler costs much more (RepairPal: about $1,043-$1,074).

items.t: Check engine light for a small evaporative emissions leak
items.job: EVAP smoke test; replace gas cap or purge valve
items.note: RepairPal lists a purge valve at about $313-$367 and a charcoal canister at about $879-$912.

items.t: Hard starting when cold
items.job: Engine computer reprogram and no-start diagnosis
items.note: RepairPal lists check engine diagnosis at about $122-$179. Plugs or a battery may also be needed.

items.t: Airbag warning light stays on
items.job: Airbag system diagnosis; replace faulty sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists an airbag crash sensor at about $289-$347 on later Grand Vitaras.

items.t: Oil leak or rattle from the timing chain cover and tensioner
items.job: Reseal timing cover and replace chain tensioner
items.note: RepairPal lists about $2,196-$2,881 for a 2007 tensioner job.

items.t: Low-beam headlight bulbs burn out often
items.job: Replace low-beam bulbs (pair)
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $124-$177 on 2006-2008 and $271-$356 on 2009-2013, where the bulb is harder to reach.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or jumps around
items.job: Test sender wiring; replace fuel level sending unit
items.note: RepairPal lists a sending unit at about $1,226-$1,485. A wiring or connector repair costs much less.

items.t: Sunroof or power window switch stops working
items.job: Replace sunroof or window switch
items.note: RepairPal lists a sunroof switch at about $120-$148 and a window switch at about $381-$402.

items.t: Overheating when towing or working hard
items.job: Cooling system pressure test and bleed; replace thermostat if needed
items.note: An owner paid about $250 for a thermostat. A radiator costs more.

items.t: Transfer case or differential seal oil leak
items.job: Replace leaking seal and refill gear oil
items.note: RepairPal lists an axle shaft seal at about $146-$211. A transfer case seal runs more because the driveshaft comes off.

items.t: Worn shocks, coil springs and bushings
items.job: Replace shocks or struts (pair)
items.note: RepairPal lists shocks or struts at about $1,181-$1,308; an owner paid about C$1,500 for springs and a shock.

items.t: A/C water leaks onto the front floor
items.job: Clear A/C evaporator drain
items.note: An owner paid about C$150 at a dealer.

items.t: Check engine light from the EGR valve
items.job: Replace EGR valve
items.note: An owner paid about $1,100. RepairPal lists EGR valve replacement at about $553-$1,152.

items.t: Heater or A/C blower stops working
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor or blower motor
items.note: RepairPal lists a blower resistor at about $119-$142 and a blower motor at about $546-$588.

items.t: Brakes grinding at low mileage
items.job: Front brake pads and rotors
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $278-$335 for pads on a 2006.

items.t: Clutch fails early on manual models
items.job: Replace clutch kit
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,505-$1,808; CarComplaints owners report about $2,000.
